description_en: Retrieves the details of a diagnostic report. 1. Call GenerateTraceDiagnose to obtain a diagnostic link. 2. Open the link in a browser to complete client-side diagnostics. 3. Call ListTraceTasks to obtain the TaskId or TraceId. 4. Call this operation to retrieve the report
description_zh: 获取诊断报告详情。1. 调用 GenerateTraceDiagnose 获取诊断链接 2. 在浏览器中打开链接完成客户端诊断 3. 调用 ListTraceTasks 获取 TaskId/TraceId 4. 调用本接口获取报告
name: DescribeTraceDiagnoseReport

parameters.description_en: The diagnostic task ID. You must specify at least one of TraceId and TaskId. If neither is specified, the API returns an error.
parameters.description_zh: 诊断任务 ID。与 TraceId/TaskId 至少需提供其中之一，两者均缺失时 API 将返回错误
